spec.title: CPU
spec.description: The "recent cpu usage" for the Java Virtual Machine process

spec.rawSql:
select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", avg(container_avg_jvm_cpu_recent_utilization) as service_environment_jvm_cpu_recent_utilization
from (SELECT $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", avg(gauge) as container_avg_jvm_cpu_recent_utilization
    FROM "jvm.cpu.recent_utilization" 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) 
    GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id"
  ) 
GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", avg(container_sum_jvm_memory_used) / avg(container_sum_jvm_memory_limit) as service_environment_jvm_memory_usage 
from (select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", sum(id_avg_jvm_memory_used) as container_sum_jvm_memory_used, sum(id_avg_jvm_memory_limit) as container_sum_jvm_memory_limit
    from (SELECT $__dateBin("jvm.memory.used".time) as time, "jvm.memory.used"."service.name", "jvm.memory.used"."deployment.environment", "jvm.memory.used"."container.id", "jvm.memory.used"."jvm.memory.pool.name", avg("jvm.memory.used".gauge) as id_avg_jvm_memory_used, avg("jvm.memory.limit".gauge) as id_avg_jvm_memory_limit 
        FROM "jvm.memory.used" join "jvm.memory.limit"
          on "jvm.memory.used".time = "jvm.memory.limit".time 
          and "jvm.memory.used"."service.name" = "jvm.memory.limit"."service.name" 
          and "jvm.memory.used"."deployment.environment" = "jvm.memory.limit"."deployment.environment" 
          and "jvm.memory.used"."container.id" = "jvm.memory.limit"."container.id" 
          and "jvm.memory.used"."jvm.memory.pool.name" = "jvm.memory.limit"."jvm.memory.pool.name" 
        WHERE $__timeFilter("jvm.memory.used".time) AND "jvm.memory.used"."service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "jvm.memory.used"."deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) and "jvm.memory.used"."jvm.memory.type" = 'heap'
        GROUP BY $__dateBin("jvm.memory.used".time), "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", "jvm.memory.pool.name"
      ) 
    GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id"
  ) 
GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", avg(action_sum_jvm_gc_duration) as service_environment_avg_jvm_gc_duration 
from (select $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", sum(sum) as action_sum_jvm_gc_duration 
    from "jvm.gc.duration" 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) 
    GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id"
  ) 
group by time, "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", avg(container_avg_jvm_class_count) as service_environment_jvm_class_count
from (SELECT $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", avg(gauge) as container_avg_jvm_class_count
    FROM "jvm.class.count" 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) 
    GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id"
  ) 
GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", avg(container_sum_jvm_thread_count) service_environment_jvm_thread_count 
from (select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", sum(daemon_sum_jvm_thread_count) as container_sum_jvm_thread_count 
    from (select time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", "jvm.thread.daemon", sum(state_avg_jvm_thread_count) as daemon_sum_jvm_thread_count 
        from (SELECT $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", "jvm.thread.daemon", "jvm.thread.state", avg(gauge) as state_avg_jvm_thread_count 
            FROM "jvm.thread.count" 
            WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) 
            GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", "jvm.thread.daemon", "jvm.thread.state"
          ) 
        GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id", "jvm.thread.daemon"
      ) 
    GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", "container.id"
  ) 
GROUP BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

SELECT $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", sum(count) as service_environment_http_server_request_duration 
FROM "http.server.request.duration" 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) 
GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

SELECT $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", sum(sum) as service_environment_http_server_request_duration 
FROM "http.server.request.duration" 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) 
GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"

SELECT $__dateBin(time) as time, "service.name", "deployment.environment", sum(count) as service_environment_http_server_request_duration 
FROM "http.server.request.duration" 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND "service.name" IN (${service:singlequote}) AND "deployment.environment" IN (${environment:singlequote}) and "http.response.status_code" ~ '(4\d+|5\d\+)'
GROUP BY $__dateBin(time), "service.name", "deployment.environment" 
ORDER BY time, "service.name", "deployment.environment"
